    Resilience and limits

    Offline safety checks5 / 5

    Fixed timing still wins some heavy-disruption cases. The gateway always returns control to the native system on invalid input or heartbeat loss.

    Research benchmark: five independently trained 300,000-step models; selection used separate validation seeds, then one frozen policy was tested on 30 unseen grid seeds and five unseen SUMO seeds. This is not authorization for live-road deployment.
